title: Montcalm to the Marine minister, Carillon, 1 Sep 1758 (ANOM COL F3 15 f.194): the figures of the code I letter, tested blind against the frozen table

documents.shelfmark: ANOM COL F3 15 (Moreau de Saint-Méry), f.194r-v, 'Duplicata' (IREL images FRANOM82_247MIOM013_F3_015_336-337, microfilm 247 MIOM 13)
documents.route: Montcalm, camp de Carillon -> Marine minister, Versailles

plaintext.source: Period decipherment written above every line of figures; clear text also in LAC's handwritten transcript of F3 15 pp.224-225 (reel C-10528, frames 1188-1189), already quoted in targets/montcalm1758i/NOTES.md; Richard 1899 calendar.

transcription.source: ANOM IREL full-resolution microfilm images (3887 x 5692 px), crops at 1800 px
transcription.notes: 7 groups cut at the right edge of the page marked ?; 4 doubtful readings marked *. Gloss transcribed separately (gloss.txt, corrected 24 Nov 2026 in two places; gloss_frozen.txt is the version measured).

system.summary: Two-part code of 700 numbered cells: letters, syllables, common words and a few names, numbers in no order against the values.

prior_solution.where: Interlinear period decipherment on the original; clear text in LAC transcript C-10528 and Richard 1899.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout downloaded the ANOM images (IREL, 23 Nov 2026) and set the rules (protocol hashed before any computation, key frozen by its upstream SHA-256, one measurement); AI agents transcribed, measured and wrote up. No person has checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: 311 groups of f.194r-v transcribed from the IREL images; the interlinear gloss transcribed apart.

Frozen table_e001295272.tsv (SHA-256 d13fcfac..., unchanged) decodes the figures; character agreement with the gloss 0.8465 vs best of 200 shuffled tables 0.2325 (mean 0.148). Criterion fixed in advance: >= 0.85 and >= best control + 0.30. Margin met, absolute threshold missed by 0.0035: by the PREREG, not confirmed (non confirmé). Measured on gloss_frozen.txt.

Exploratory, declared after the measurement: the same table with the Lévis close-up readings (levis_detail_concordance.tsv agreed_reading) gives 0.891 (controls best 0.236). Cells 2 (nécessaire), 16 (n), 355 (homme) are the main gains. Also exploratory, after the fact: the frozen table against the gloss corrected in two places (gloss.txt: 'ou la Belle Rivière', 'toute la campagne', pointed out by Daniel Bourdeau) gives 0.8517 (controls best 0.233; result_exploratory_gloss.txt). Neither changes the result, 0.8465, not confirmed.

outcome.method_basis: The period interlinear decipherment gives the text; the figures confirm that the letter is in code I (Moras's 1758 Marine cipher), a text the table had never seen.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 194/194 words of the interlinear gloss legible (gloss.txt); 131/194 (67.5%) also supported letter-for-letter by the frozen table, 145/194 (74.7%) with the Lévis readings.
